title: Big Walk
genre: Online co-op exploration / social 'walk and talk' adventure with puzzles and proximity voice chat (separate variants for 2, 3 and 4+ players)
release_date: 2026-08-04 (Steam/PC, Mac, PS5, Nintendo Switch 2 simultaneously; included in PlayStation Plus that month)
developer: House House (Melbourne, Australia): Nico Disseldorp, Jake Strasser, Stuart Gillespie-Cook, Michael McMaster, plus Kalonica Quigley (hired between Untitled Goose Game and Big Walk)
team_size: 5 full-time [CONFIRMED – Kotaku interview; Wikipedia lists the 4 founders]. Panic (publisher) staff and any contractors are not counted. Group B (≤5 core).
developer_background: Veteran indie team: Push Me Pull You (2016) and Untitled Goose Game (2019, Panic-published global hit; reached 1M sales ~3 months after release). Big Walk began as a pandemic-lockdown experiment and grew into a ~6-year project. Panic backed it after a one-page pitch [CONFIRMED – GamesIndustry.biz via GameDev.net].
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478500/Big_Walk/ ; also Mac, PS5 (PlayStation Plus monthly game at launch) and Nintendo Switch 2
business_model: Premium $19.99 with a 25% launch discount (~$14.99) [CONFIRMED – Panic press release]; also licensed into PlayStation Plus for launch month (deal terms undisclosed). Patches continuing (1.5.1).
units_or_downloads: 1,000,000+ copies in 6 days, announced 2026-08-10, all platforms combined [CONFIRMED – Panic via Game Informer, Gematsu, Game Developer]. It is unclear whether PS Plus claims are included (probably not; they are not 'sold'). Steam-only: ~858k [ESTIMATE – Steam Page Analyzer, Boxleiter on 23,191 reviews]. Steam units from ~35k all-language reviews × 30–40 ≈ 1.05M–1.4M [ESTIMATE, ~Sep 2026]. Latest total (Oct 2026): no data.
peak_concurrent_players: 46,409 on Steam over the opening weekend (~2026-08-08/09) [ESTIMATE – SteamDB via Mein-MMO/Outlook Respawn]; Raijin 21,015 at its 2026-08-05 snapshot (before the weekend peak). Console CCU: no data.
steam_reviews: ~35,062 all-language, 96% positive (Steam Swedish-locale capture, ~Sep 2026); English-only 26,788, 96% 'Overwhelmingly Positive'; last 30 days ~97%. Early: 7,111 at 91% (Mein-MMO, launch week); 1,553 at 86% (Raijin, 2026-08-05).
implied_review_multiplier: n/a for a clean calibration (the 1M CONFIRMED figure is multi-platform). Rough: if ~60–70% of the 1M were Steam, that is ~600–700k Steam units ÷ ~7–10k Steam reviews around Aug 10 ≈ 60–100 [ESTIMATE, low confidence]. For ongoing estimates, a 30–40 multiplier (premium $20 Western co-op) matches GameDiscoverCo's revenue.
gross_revenue: ≈ $21M Steam gross in Aug 2026, #3 new Steam release by revenue for August [ESTIMATE – GameDiscoverCo August 2026 report]. Steam Page Analyzer: ~$17.2M [ESTIMATE]. Spec method: ~1.05M–1.4M Steam units × ($19.99 × 0.75 = $14.99) ≈ $15.8M–$21M [ESTIMATE]. PS5/Switch 2/Mac sales and the PS Plus fee: no data. Chosen: ~$21M Steam (Aug), probably $25M+ all platforms (unquantified).
net_revenue: ≈ $14.2M from Steam [ESTIMATE – $21M − Steam cut (30% on first $10M = $3.0M; 25% on $11M = $2.75M) = $15.25M × 0.93], shared between House House and Panic (split undisclosed). Console and PS Plus revenue on top: no data.
production_cost: ≈ $1.7M–$2.2M [ESTIMATE – 4–5 people × ~72 months × $6k/month (Australia lean indie)], funded/backed by Panic. Untitled Goose Game income likely subsidised the early years. No disclosed figure.
development_time: ~6 years (lockdown experiment ~2020 → Aug 2026) [CONFIRMED – House House via GamesIndustry.biz/GameDev.net]
why_popular: A pure social premise: you just walk and talk with friends through a beautiful world. Physically modelled proximity voice chat (voices fade with distance, echo in tunnels, muffle through glass, crackle through walkie-talkies) creates emergent, funny and heartfelt moments. Light puzzles reward communication. Wholesome, non-violent co-op appeals beyond core gamers. It carries the Untitled Goose Game pedigree and Panic curation, was treated as a GOTY contender (Kotaku), and was on PS Plus at launch for huge exposure.
marketing_channels: Panic publisher PR and press-release cadence (launch, 1M); House House brand recognition; PlayStation Plus inclusion at launch; simultaneous multi-platform launch (PC/Mac/PS5/Switch 2); press features on the proximity chat mechanic before launch (Waxy, June 2026); Steam top-seller placement (#2 in sales one day after launch per Inven Global); streamers and friend-group word of mouth. Demo/Next Fest/wishlists: no data.
engine: Unity [ESTIMATE – Indie Hive game listing; consistent with Untitled Goose Game being Unity; no dev statement found]
art_style: Soft, stylised, minimalist 3D landscapes with flat colours and a cosy, hand-crafted feel (House House signature style)
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: code the networking glue, proximity voice attenuation (Steam/Vivox/EOS voice + distance/occlusion filters), the movement controller and puzzle scripting, and generate placeholder or low-poly environment assets, ambience and SFX. | AI cannot: replace the hand-crafted world design, environmental puzzle design for 2/3/4+ player variants, art direction and the 6 years of tuning that make walking itself feel good, writing and pacing, or the publisher (Panic) and PS Plus deal. A 'walk with friends plus proximity chat' MVP is easy, but competing at this polish level is not. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity 6 or Godot 4 + Steam Networking + Vivox/EOS voice or Steam Voice + steam-audio for occlusion + Meshy/Tripo + Blender + ElevenLabs ambience + Suno.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 4–8 weeks for a small proximity-chat walking sandbox with 2–3 puzzles, ~$300–$800 (Claude Max, 3D/audio gen, asset packs, Steam Direct $100). Excludes living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 12–24 months for a comparable hand-crafted world, ~$10,000–$40,000 (tools, art/environment freelancers, sound design, extensive playtesting, trailer/PR). Excludes living costs. Realistically below Big Walk's polish level.

data_conflicts: (1) Team size: 4 (Wikipedia, founders) vs 5 full-time (Kotaku, incl. Kalonica Quigley). Chosen 5, so Group B, borderline. (2) Gross: GameDiscoverCo ~$21M (Aug, Steam) vs Steam Page Analyzer ~$17.2M. Chosen GDCo. (3) Peak CCU: 46,409 (SteamDB, opening weekend) vs 21,015 (Raijin, Aug 5 snapshot before the peak) vs SteamSpy's 24,444 'yesterday' peak. Chosen 46,409. (4) Whether the 1M figure includes PS Plus claims is unspecified by Panic. (5) Reviews: English 26,788 vs all-language ~35,062. Both reported.
notes: This is the 'craft' counterpoint to the friendslop cluster: a 5-person veteran team, 6 years, Panic publishing, a $20 price and multi-platform plus PS Plus. Its Steam CCU (46k) was much lower than How to Fish or Meccha Chameleon, but August revenue was comparable thanks to a 4× higher price. The reusable insight for a solo creator is that physically modelled proximity voice chat is a cheap, high-impact social mechanic (an older precedent is Lethal Company); it can be prototyped in weeks, but a hand-crafted world at this level cannot.
